columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for a work pattern assignment.

columns.name: SOURCE_WORK_PAT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of work pattern template which was used to create the work pattern.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person ID to which the work pattern is assigned.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Assignment ID of the person to which the work pattern is assigned.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the work pattern associated to this work pattern assignment.

columns.name: WORK_PATTERN_CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of work pattern that is assigned.

columns.name: DATE_FROM
columns.description: Date from which the assignment of the work pattern is valid.

columns.name: DATE_TO
columns.description: Date up to which the assignment of the work pattern is valid.

columns.name: ANCHOR_DATE
columns.description: Date belonging to a week which follows Week 1 of the multi-week pattern.

columns.name: ANCHOR_NUM
columns.description: Identifies the period in repeating period unit during which work pattern starts.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source through which work pattern was created

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
